keyProps.mergeProps(a,b,c?,d?,e?): Up to 5 prop sets. Each argument is a props object OR a function (otherProps) => otherProps that receives the props merged so far (left-to-right); with a function YOU chain handlers yourself.
keyProps.mergePropsN(props[]): Array form of the same merge; slightly slower — prefer mergeProps for <=5 sets.
keyProps.makeEventPreventable(event): Adds the preventBaseUIHandler method to a React synthetic event.
keyProps.mergeClassNames(our, their): Concatenates two class names (undefined if both empty).

mergeSemantics.style: keys merged, rightmost overwrites earlier keys
mergeSemantics.handlers: merged and executed right-to-left (rightmost runs first)
mergeSemantics.ref: NOT merged — only the rightmost ref is kept
mergeSemantics.prevention: For React synthetic events Base UI adds event.preventBaseUIHandler(); calling it stops Base UI's internal logic (it does NOT call preventDefault/stopPropagation). Handlers returned from function-form arguments must check event.baseUIHandlerPrevented themselves.
mergeSemantics.nonSynthetic: For custom (non-synthetic) events all handlers always run; prevention unavailable.

renderProp: The merge helper for `render` callbacks and for custom components that accept a render prop: `render={(props, state) => <button {...mergeProps<'button'>(props, { className: styles.Button })} />}`. For ref merging use useRender's `ref` array parameter, never mergeProps.
notableDifferences: Repo imports mergeProps + filterDOMProps from @react-aria/utils — 1 usage: registry/untitledui/components/base/file-upload-trigger/file-upload-trigger.tsx:9. Swap keeps className/style/handler behaviour but adds preventBaseUIHandler/baseUIHandlerPrevented semantics RAC lacks.
No ref merging (RAC's mergeProps merges refs). Call sites relying on that must use useRender's `ref` array or merge manually.
Function-form prop sets (compute-from-previous) have no RAC equivalent.
